text:
ana_partnerops: Quick sync — vendor update from today's HW call: NVIDIA flagged a potential microcode regression affecting H100 perf at long sequences. Tentative ask: move our joint-announce embargo by ~2 weeks to allow SI image smoke. Can the marketplace/comms team absorb that shift?

sam_platform: ack. Do we know if this affects H200/B200 timelines too or just H100?

lei_hw: it's isolated to H100 at the moment; firmware team pushing a microcode patch but want an extra validation pass on our inference image. MI300/Gaudi unaffected. @ana_partnerops — vendor recommended we run a 48h soak on canary images across both EU and US regions.

maria_pm: hmm. Two-week slip would cascade into press ops and partner marketing. We have prebooked PR slots w/ partner for week-of-5/13. If we delay, need new embargo windows and a soft customer notification plan. Can we do a limited canary announce to SIs first?

ana_partnerops (correction): typo — meant @ana_partnerops above :)

ana_partnerops: re: canary announce — vendor is OK with a staged reveal: SI partners + marketplace listing gated until full lab signoff. That buys us flexibility.

simon_sales: customer impact = we need to flag enterprise accounts on reserved capacity (Dedicated) that had H100 pinned. Ops: any automated reroute to MI300/H200 fallback we can enable for them? 

sam_platform: yes — we can set a routing policy to fallback to MI300 quantized variant for pinned customers for reads; need to coordinate with sales to update TnC for a short window. Also need to ensure model compatibility (kernel selection).

lei_hw: lab checklist (short):
```
- build canary image: vendor-fw-patch-2026-05
- run 48h inference soak @ typical seq distribution
- verify KV cache stability and batching latency tail
- snapshot telemetry and share with vendor
```

lei_hw: will run tonight in staging; ETA for soak results = 48-60h.

maria_pm: marketing ask: If we move embargo, we need to hold creative + adjust ad buys. I'll push a preliminary notice to partner comms and get alternative PR dates. Also prepping a short customer-facing blurb in case sales needs to respond now.

ana_partnerops: ops doc draft for partner handoff below — will iterate: 
```
- current status: H100 microcode regression (vendor)
- impact surface: marketplace listing embargo, SI dry-run, reserved capacity pinning
- immediate mitigation: enable MI300 fallback policy for pinned customers; schedule canary soak; delay PR by 2 weeks tentative
- owners: lei_hw (lab), sam_platform (routing), maria_pm (comms), simon_sales (customer outreach)
- follow-ups: M+2 post-soak sync, final embargo call with vendor
```

simon_sales: I'll flag top 10 affected accounts and draft email templates. Want to avoid surprise support tickets.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace/canary-image -> staging at 2026-05-18T02:30Z (CI #78532).

sam_platform: note for partners: we should also check marketplace SKU tagging and installer CI so SI images don't get stale if we re-run canary. migration script: `scripts/sync-sku-tags --from=canary --to=staging`

maria_pm: thanks — team, can we target a vendor + Redwood embargo reconvene on 2026-05-20 to decide final announce? If lab soak is green before then we may keep original PR dates with a narrow mitigation note.

ana_partnerops: agreed. I'll book the vendor call for 2026-05-20 16:00 PT and cc SI leads.

lei_hw: will post soak telemetry links in the thread once available. If anything fails, we'll escalate to vendor FW eng.

sam_platform: one more ops ask — ops/integrations: add an ephemeral canary routing rule and a rollback playbook. I'll open an internal ticket.

simon_sales: :thumbsup: appreciate the heads up. I'll prep customer comms templates and share in #support.

maria_pm: tagging in marketing ops to hold creative until we lock the embargo.

ana_partnerops: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for the next 72h. Short updates only pls.
